name: Skater Hop
instructions: Stand on one foot with a slight knee bend.
Hop sideways to the other foot.
Swing your free leg behind you for balance.
Bound back to the other side.
longevityNotes: Cardiovascular fitness is the single strongest predictor of a long, active life. Regular cardio work keeps the heart, lungs, and brain in shape for decades.
overview: A lateral bounding jump that trains single-leg power and balance.
